record: 2026-11-22. English dictation cleanup on one Apple M4 Pro. Bench only. No app, ASR, model publication or verifier change.

decision.quality: Keep v6b Q8_0 and the existing merge. The blend lost a delivered counterfactual exact match. No delivered-quality challenger qualified.
decision.speed: Use the exact arm64 selector and optional full-vocabulary verified tagger drafts in a warm benchmark process. Leave the tagger and every rewrite out of the app.
decision.bypass: Not a text-preserving improvement. The bypass kept the main pass counts, but lost one delivered exact trap and changed a delivered challenge answer. Faster median on Sol does not remove those regressions.
decision.stop: Frozen experiments complete. A fresh human cohort, rather than more fitting to these references, is required for a claim about meaning or usefulness.

hardware.power: AC; serialized Mac model work via gpulock. No energy or cross-device claim.

rules.model_selection: Rank dev delivered exact, raw exact, then fewer changed clean sources. Freeze at most one challenger per mechanism before reading the new challenge.
rules.confirmation: At least 35/36 raw hand passes, no decrease in delivered trap passes or delivered cf6 exact matches, no new accepted harmful probe, no harmful full candidate delivered, no new lexical meaning failures on fresh challenge.
rules.speed: At least 5% lower warm p50 or p95 on sol200; neither more than 3% worse. Check pass order and byte equality for a lossless arm.
rules.units: Paired gains and losses refer to the same cases. P-values are descriptive exact sign tests, two-sided; the convenience sets are not random samples of users. On the new challenge each authored pair is one natural unit.

new_challenge.screen: Drop the whole pair for a normalized match or shared six-word run on either side of training, validation or monitored regressions. No verifier filtering. Cases, references and lexical rules were independently authored before selection. No human labels.

ceiling.scope: Upper bound on reference exactness under this verifier on these inputs, not on human quality.

unchanged_verifier.interpretation: No harmful candidate accepted or returned byte-for-byte. The old check.py word-sequence proxy still flags 11 of 499 refuse probes in round 1. Do not call those safe. Both rounds also refuse legitimate edits.

native_selector.method: Native request time; no Python, transport or merge. Scalar and NEON, same v6b n2-m24 model and traces.

separate_component_screen.method: Before integration. Native timings and sums with separately measured tagger compute or tagger pipe (warm_compute / warm_pipe); not an end-to-end measurement. Forward then reverse.

initial_factorial_service.method: warm single request, input ready in Python to merged answer including proposed tokens, encoding, pipe round trip, Qwen and merge; per case median of six, fwd/rev. Cold process/imports and lock wait excluded. One shared NEON executable with --draft-text-m enabled; no external draft on plain. Shortcut bypasses inference; stack adds hints on non-bypassed inputs.

source_as_proposal_control.method: untrained proposer vs trained proposer with identical verified target; ancillary control, not model selection Same transport and merge; source uses the unchanged input as the draft. This was not a new tuned finalist.

final_service.design: Serial fresh stdio process for each arm in each pass; exactly 3 warm repetitions after 2 warmups. Reverse arm and suite order on pass 2. No tagger or --draft-text-m on default. Hint arm keeps Tagger in client and uses --draft-text-m 24. Timed from source ready to delivered string, including proposals, encoding, IPC, native model and merge. Compare against sealed stock greedy outputs on every request outside timing. p95 is sorted per-case median at round(.95*(N-1)).

cold_process.definition: Source ready in parent to merged result from fresh Python client, including process startup, model loads, draft, first inference, IPC and merge. File cache not flushed; excludes lock wait and teardown. One short synthetic request, 3 fresh processes per arm.

decoder_checks.note: The same chosen ids, EOS, bytes and delivered text on these traces do not guarantee equal logits. A new batch shape can change low margins.

checks.interactive_probe: Two serial replies before EOF, including a wrong draft; malformed input terminates without a reply.
checks.private_page: Pilot prepared, not opened or rated. Earlier synthetic headless export/import test made no HTTP requests.

commands.environment: L="$HOME/polish-lab"; F="$L/frontier". Private rows, assignment keys and unpublished weights are not in Git. All inference uses one gpulock; do not wrap a self-locking shell launcher.
commands.model_confirmation: (cd "$F" && python3 confirm.py run && python3 confirm.py score)
